intro: Lesson 5: The honest trader, Khadijah and the Cave of Hira. To understand how the Prophet's ﷺ honesty earned trust and how the first revelation came in the Cave of Hira

passage.title: al-Alaq 96:1-5
paras: Read in the name of your Lord who created. Created man from a clinging substance. Read, and your Lord is the most Generous, who taught by the pen, taught man that which he knew not.

questions.a: Because he was always honest and trustworthy
questions.model: People left their valuables with him. He never lied or cheated. So they named him al-Amin: the trustworthy.

questions.q: Where did the first revelation come?
How old was he at the first revelation?
Add the trader years, marriage and Hira to your timeline strip with captions.
questions.a: Trader for Khadijah; married Khadijah; age 40: first revelation in Hira.

questions.q: list two good deeds Khadijah reminded him of.
questions.a: He kept ties with family and helped the weak.

questions.q: why did his honesty help people believe him later?
questions.a: They knew he had never lied, so they had reason to trust his message.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how did the Prophet ﷺ earn trust?
questions.a: By always being honest, over many years.
